scope: California K52 / House 435 first actual census-block solve with population-aware recorded water links and 1000 inner iterations.

baseline.meaning: Preserved strict topology preflight; no solved plan or final population-balance baseline.

configuration.physical_adjacency_rule: polygon parts; disjoint interiors; positive-length shared boundary; F***1****
configuration.eligibility_note: The 99% root threshold and 1% optimistic integer-seat preflight guide link selection only. They are not guarantees or acceptance thresholds for final whole-block population balance.
configuration.boundary_metric: source census coverage including retained water blocks; no shoreline substitution

inner_optimization.normalization: population-mass and geometry-derived shifted squared costs; mean-zero weight gauge
inner_optimization.public_units: centers in source coordinate units; weights in squared source coordinate units
inner_optimization.failure_policy: raise on unsuccessful termination or nonfinite output; no completed plan returned

projection.distance_model: approximate local plane; distortion increases across broad states

input.location_source: TIGER INTPT internal points, not household locations or population centroids

outer_termination.disclosure: The outer loop reached the 80-iteration limit without center convergence. Successful inner optimizer passes do not establish outer convergence. Final population balance and connectivity are assessed separately after repair/rebalancing.

validation_note: 715 prelaunch districting/script tests and 18 focused summary checks passed. Terminal evidence, source DBF, trace arithmetic, map hashes, endpoint ownership, and preservation were independently verified. Browser QA confirmed all 52 district totals, six links, physical exceptions, national/state/exact outlines, Channel Islands and Farallons views, individual-link inspection, hide/show, explicit San Francisco county loading and clearing with no initial block detail, and both pass-2 charts (390 iterations / 407 evaluations). Map and comparison console warning/error logs were empty; validated-channel-islands.png preserves the rendered regional view.
limitations: The original run stopped before optimization. This is not a controlled 300-versus-1000 iteration experiment or a completed-plan speed comparison.
A successful inner optimizer, outer center convergence, final population balance, physical connectivity and recorded-link connectivity are distinct outcomes.
The 1% root/group population budget selects links; it is not final district-balance acceptance.
Connections preserve source polygons and populations. Open-Pacific attribution uses source-component clearance and official regional geography, not a global high-resolution shoreline certificate.
Objective changes are meaningful within each pass only; intermediate trace populations are point assignments before connectivity repair.
Pilot timings are from a shared desktop and include observational tracing. The original preflight built the historical block graph; the pilot uses a part graph and new policy.
Map byte counts describe gzip artifacts, not browser memory or network latency. County detail loads only on request.
